item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E006","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"UNICEF’s 2023–2027 Egypt country-program assessment reported that government programs aimed to strengthen basic services, increase access to social services, and provide protection for families in need; it also reported that nearly 30% of Egyptians lived in poverty, with substantially higher rates in parts of Upper Egypt.","notes":["The excerpt describes the programs’ aims or role, but does not establish that they had expanded those services or protection outcomes."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
